script: Hi hi, it’s Miku! 💙 Okay, why are RGB sunset fans suddenly everywhere? Because they’re basically a mini breeze machine and a cozy light show in one! You get that soft sunset glow, dreamy colors on your wall, and just enough airflow to make your desk feel fancy. People love them for gaming setups, study corners, and late-night chill vibes because they make tiny spaces look instantly upgraded. It’s like… part fan, part mood lamp, part “my room is now a vibe.” And yes, if a gadget can make you cooler and cuter at the same time, the internet will absolutely adopt it.
